This implies a potential pathway where Taxifolin 3-O-beta-D-xylopyranoside may inhibit Tyrosine--tRNA ligase, thereby affecting the sodium/bile acid cotransporter. The integration of these targets highlights a possible regulatory role for Taxifolin 3-O-beta-D-xylopyranoside in modulating bile acid transport, though the exact nature of its interaction with the cotransporter remains to be fully elucidated. The observed scores suggest a moderate level of interaction, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct involvement of Taxifolin 3-O-beta-D-xylopyranoside in this process.
